subject: Adding color to the R graphs.

messages.author: ece7617b26cd865b
messages.subject: Adding color to the R graphs.
parts:
Hi!

Although it is possible to add colors to your charts on R, I would like to know if it's possible to have R automatically add colors to the output charts (as is the case in Google Charts) without explicitly coding that in. I'm still a newbie at this so please feel free to guide me in the right direction if this question has been asked before.

Thank you for your time!

Sid

Here's a shiny version of the question.  My experimenting seems to indicate that trellis.par.set() does not work for the graphs produced in a shiny app.  But perhaps I just need to know where to locate the call to trellis.par.set().   Instead I have had to use par.settings in each lattice plot.

Is there a way to set the global lattice theme in one place for all lattice plots in a shiny app?

Each time reactivePlot is used, it creates and closes a png device. Look at the impl of reactivePlot, it's fairly straightforward. Eh, sorta. So I guess yes, you'll have to call par each time.
